description: What the cook keeps on Befana: saved recipes, recipes they published, their own versions, shopping lists and meal plans, their ratings, a pantry count. Use when the cook asks "what did I save?", "pull up last week's list", "show my recipes", or (section: photos) "which of my recipes need a better photo?". Same as My Kitchen on the website. If newly_assigned is present, say its line first, once (Befana added those recipes; hand_back_recipe returns one that isn't theirs). If fixes_asked is present, pass the fixes on once and offer to make them with update_recipe after showing the changes.

section.description: photos: the cook's recipes with no cover, a placeholder, or a cover below Befana's photo standard, worst first (not part of all)
